tc.research_page.TB.Thauminite.1: Refine a thaumium ingot in the crucible using all six primal aspects, Vitreus, and Fabrico. The process yields eight thauminite nuggets.
tc.research_page.TB.Quicksilver.1: Use Ordo and Venenum in the crucible to extract quicksilver from a silverwood log.
tc.research_page.CAP_thauminite.1: Craft the caps at the arcane workbench. They reduce vis consumption by 15%.
tc.research_page.TB.Plax.1: Sometimes a thaumaturge just needs to get him some string - for magical candles or for magical clothes - it does not matter that much what for. And sometimes a thaumaturge just does not want to fight spiders for endless nights or shear sheep for wool to process later. You have applied the knowledge of plants and nature you've just learned to solve the problem for you. The result is a strange crop, named Plax, which will grow on farmland in 8 stages and once fully grown will produce 3 string! It functions just like a regular wheat crop - it also needs light and will only grow on farmland.
tc.research_text.TB.Metalleat: Iron is good for your health
tc.research_page.TB.Metalleat.1: Sometimes a thaumaturge needs some metallum for his ore processing. And there goes an iron ingot. Sometimes a thaumaturge needs metallum for his crafts. And there goes more iron. You have discovered a way to put an end to this misery - by infusing a regular wheat seeds in a crucible with some metallum and victus to keep the life in the seeds you have managed to create a plant, that grows exactly like wheat, but gets tough and metallic in the latest stages of growth. It then can be harvested to obtain some Iron Nuggets. This discovery asks more questions than it answeres though, and you might need to research it further... As far as you can tell you can't replicate the same with thaumium.
tc.research_page.TB.Lucrite.1: You have researched the Metalleat further and discovered, that you can create a similar crop by infusing a carrot with Lucrum. The result is a very strange crop. It functions just like the Metalleat, but takes twice as much time to grow. It is also very magic dependant - without strong enough source of magic beneath the soil it grows in it refuses to grow. Those Salis Mundus blocks seem to be just as perfect as possible. It will also accept bonemeal with much slower rate, taking 7 bonemeal to grow. However, should you let it grow and it will grow some Golden Nuggets on it's branches. Since it is a carrot it is also possible to obtain one from the crop.
tc.research_page.TB.Lazullia.1: Sometimes a thaumaturge needs some lapis for his... thaumaturgy. And sometimes a thaumaturge is just too lazy to venture down into caves just to spend a good 5 hours searching for that blue ore. You have once again used plants to aid you with this noncense. Lazullia will slowly grow and once fully grown can be harvested. Upon harvesting a thaumaturge will recieve some Lapis Lazuli alongside with a seed.
tc.research_text.TB.Glieonia: How do you even pronounce that
tc.research_page.TB.Glieonia.1: What's the most awesome thing about thaumaturgy? Flight! Well, what is the next best thing? Warding foci? Well, what is the thrid best thing... Digging foci, really? We are talking about Nitor, okay?! Jees. Anyway, Nitor is pretty amazing - it shines brightly, creates fancy particles, all that fancy stuff! Well, there is one thing - it requires glowstone to make... A wise thaumaturge can solve this nuance! You have managed to create a plant, that once fully grown will drop 2 Glowstone dust. interestingly enough the flower does not emmit any light whatsoever, even when fully grown... Why could that be?..
tc.research_page.TB.SMB.1: Compress nine pieces of Salis Mundus in an arcane workbench. Place the block beneath farmland to grow Lucrite.
tc.research_page.TB.BasicPlants.1: Thaumaturhy is rich in directions it affects. Alchemy, Infusion, Enchanting... Thaumaturgy can do everything... However, most thaumaturges ignore a very important aspect - the plants and plantlife. You, however, are not "most thaumaturges". This direction of researches promises alot, you can already see the possibilities of this. Well, it is so research rich that even this fact has allowed you to figure out the creation of the first Thaumic Plant - the Sweed. This is technically a weed. However, should you let it grow for a little - it will grow to a full size, and can be harvested to drop sugar and reeds. However, it should be watched over, since it does rapidly spreads!
tc.research_page.TB.Redlon.1: Even though thaumaturgy is a magical art and is not related to industry in any way a lot of magical devices can actually operate or be controlled by that mythical red dust - the Redstone. Actually redstone seems pretty magical itself. What if you combine it with a plant? Well, the result is a plant, that will slowly grow a Block Of Redstone, just like a Melon or a Pumpkin. It however requires much more time than melons or pumpkins.
tc.research_page.TB.Ashroom.1: Those vishrooms were bugging thaumaturges for quite a while. What are they? Why are there so many in the magical forest? What are they even usefull for? You think, that you can finally answer this question. It seems like those vishrooms are just a huge storage of aspects... Without the ability to burst them. Who have done that to the poor shrooms stays unknown, but you have managed to restore that ability through a very simple crucible magic. If you let your new Primal Shrooms grow and then harvest them they will cover everything around themself in a rain of primal aspect orbs!
tc.research_page.TB.Flaxium.1: This plant looks funny. You had no intentions on constructing something like that, but - oh well, you are here, with this thing in your hands, it is a little too late to worry about things. You have created a flower that activly absorbs flux from nearby air - however, it instantly builds up again - and once it has collected enough flux it releases it in a form of Flux Gas above itself. You are not sure about the uses of this plant, but it's ability to absorb aspects from surroundings seems interesting, maybe it can be used as a base for something bigger?..
tc.research_page.TB.Tobacco.1: Grow tobacco on farmland and grind the harvested leaves with a pestle and mortar at the arcane workbench. Hold use with the greatwood pipe and ground tobacco in your inventory for a chance to remove temporary warp.
tc.research_page.TB.Tobacco.Angry.1: You have long ago heard about some kind of warriors of fury, who used to smoke before each battle. They were a very scary warriors - without pain and with unstopabble fury they once were tearing their enemies apart. They are long gone, but the secret of their battle fury? You have discovered a way to infuse your tobacco with required magic to get a piece of their fury. Smoke this tobacco before a battle - and you will tear your enemies apart, just like those warriors!
tc.research_page.TB.Tobacco.Mining.1: You have heard of some mythical herbs that can gain their smoker such a strength that they are able to break stone in mere seconds with bare fists! Old tales of the east. It might be impossible to break stones in a mere second, but you have managed to create a tobacco, that will at least help you with casual mining. Smoke it before you go mining, and you should be able to mine stone and ores much faster than regular. The effect sure will wear of ofter some time too.
tc.research_page.TB.Tobacco.Wisdom.1: You have gone beyond the relaxing properties of the tobacco. Infusing your tobacco with knowledge sure was a great idea - you have managed to create a tobacco, which puts you in a crystal clear mind state once you smoke it. The effect lasts a mere second, though it is more than enough to make a shocking discovery or two. However, you are afraid, that you may also see something horrible there, which will corrupt your mind... Well, who does not risk - does not get his reward, right?
tc.research_page.TB.Tobacco.Tainted.1: You are not quite sure why you have even discovered this. Sure, now you can infuse your tobacco with taint, forever changing it, so anyone, who smokes it will have his mind corrupted by taint, and all the horrors of the dark will appear in his mind, but what is it even usefull for? The taint pieces also leave tiny signs on the pipe of the smoker. You are interested in the ways this will affect things like silverwood... Probably nothing good though.
tc.research_page.TB.Tobacco.Sanity.1: Well, most thaumaturges use different smoking herbs to 'relax'. You do not need that kind of relaxation, no. They are fools, who will soon loose their magic if they continue doing so! However, your mind might need some relaxation from that warp. Sure, just a regular tobacco does the trick, but you can do it better, can you?.. You have created a perfect tobacco, which calms down your nerves and removes temporary warp.
tc.research_page.TB.Tobacco.Saturating.1: You have found a way to stop hunger starvation. Smoking the tobacco with the addition of seeds and some primal aspects tricks the mind into thinking, that the body has already feasted. As you can guess it is pretty dangerous, since the body is not recieving food, but if things get too tough this may help you last for a while. It, however, can have some negatives on your body, so you might want to be carefull.
tc.research_page.TB.Tobacco.Eldritch.1: You have discovered a way to infuse regular tobacco powder with some eldritch energy. The result may not be that safe to smoke, however, should a thaumaturge smoke such a thing his vision will go grim for some time. Thaumaturge with such a vision should not look at living beings. It is also possible to attract the attention of "eldritch" by doing so, however the chances are low. The tobacco might cause sanity problems!
tc.research_page.TB.Tobacco.Wispy.1: What happens if you infuse more magic into your tobacco? That is an interesting questing, but the answer is much more facinating! You have discovered a way to properly infuse some magic into your tobacco. The result seems to be fairly safe to smoke - it does not seem to carry negatives within itself. However, should you smoke such a tobacco a tiny life form pops out of your smoking pipe - a Wisp. It also seems rather angry - you think that's because wisps do not like enclosed spaces. Or maybe the smoke is the reason?
tc.research_page.TB.SilverwoodPipe.1: Most tobaccos what you have managed to create are safe. Not all of them though. You think, that the only soultion here is to get a better pipe. Silverwood can be just perfect for that. It is however not as mundane as the greatwood is and requires much more complex processes than just arcane crafting. The silverwood smoking pipe is a better pipe - it negates most of negative effects on your tobaccoes, and once that have no negatives will instead have additional positive effects.
tc.research_page.TB.CrystalBlocks.1: Use a crystal cluster in the crucible to make a solid crystal block. Adding Taint produces a tainted crystal block. Blocks and slabs can stabilise infusion when placed symmetrically.
tc.research_page.TB.LegacySlabs.1: Craft three matching legacy blocks in a row to obtain three slabs.
tc.research_page.TB.AlchemyRestoration.1: Restore gravel to cobblestone and reshape stone bricks with Ordo. Use Terra to turn ice into packed ice.
tc.research_page.TB.SM.1: Combine Salis Mundus with Praecantatio and the six primal aspects in a crucible to obtain two piles of Salis Mundus.
tc.research_page.TB.VoidSeed.1: Infuse a void seed with several crops to make it plantable. Sow it on farmland and harvest the mature crop for a regular void seed and a seed to replant.
tc.research_page.TB.VoidTools.1: These shears and flint and steel slowly repair themselves in your inventory. Each contributes one point of gear warp.
tc.research_page.ROD_tbthaumium.1: Stores 80 vis of each primal aspect and slowly replenishes nearly empty aspects.
tc.research_page.ROD_tbvoid.1: Stores 160 vis of each primal aspect and slowly replenishes nearly empty aspects.
tc.research_page.TB.GoldenOak.1: Not only weeds and flowers can be magically processed to create something new! Trees have that potential too! However, they are too strong on their own, and therefore they resist any simple magical additions. Infusion should do the job just fine! You have managed to create a Golden Oak tree, just as an example. This tree works just as regular Oak does, however, should it drop an apple - and that apple will be covered in gold! It, however, is impossible to get the mythical Enchanted Golden Apple. Due to being infused with Greed essentia tree will drop much less sapligns, since it wants to be the only one absorbing the sunlight and water.
tc.research_page.TB.PeacefulSapling.1: You have noticed that the animals of all kind are attracted to the light. You have also noticed that they can appear in different places out of nowhere. You have studied that effect, and have managed to create a tree that will attract animals of all kind towards itself. The animals, corresponding to the biome the tree grows in will randomly appear beneath it's leaves. You should however keep control over the population, since animals will come endlessly!
tc.research_page.TB.NetherSapling.1: You have managed to combine your knowledge of the Portal to the Nether with your knowledge of thaumic trees. The result is a tree, that creates tiny portals to the nether beneath itself. Those portals can't be seen, but they are strong enought for the nether corruption to pass through, converting mundane blocks below the tree into their nether equivalent. Different creatures from the nether will also occasionally come through those portals. The tree also has the properties of the netherrack where it will not burn and spread fire but will forever sustain it.
tc.research_page.TB.EnderSapling.1: You have managed to apply your knowledge of the mythical land known as The End to your knowledge about trees. This tree, infused with ender energies will convert mundane blocks below itself to blocks from The End - the endstone. It is also possible to obtain obsidian, though the odds are low. Strangely enough the matter of the world under the tree seems extremely thick and occasionally creatures from The End will escape to the world the tree grows in, however it is impossible for some big creatures like Dragons to come through. The wood can be used to make special planks with a pretty high explosion resistance.
tc.research_page.TB.Bracelet.Iron.1: Stores 10 vis of each primal aspect. Equip and use wand foci as you would with a wand.
tc.research_page.TB.Bracelet.Gold.1: Stores 15 vis of each primal aspect. Equip and use wand foci as you would with a wand.
tc.research_page.TB.Bracelet.Greatwood.1: Stores 17 vis of each primal aspect. Equip and use wand foci as you would with a wand.
tc.research_page.TB.Bracelet.Thaumium.1: Stores 20 vis of each primal aspect. Equip and use wand foci as you would with a wand.
Stores 23 vis of each primal aspect. Equip and use wand foci as you would with a wand.
tc.research_page.TB.Bracelet.Reed.1: Stores 23 vis of each primal aspect. Equip and use wand foci as you would with a wand.
tc.research_page.TB.Bracelet.Bone.1: Stores 25 vis of each primal aspect. Equip and use wand foci as you would with a wand.
tc.research_page.TB.Bracelet.Obsidian.1: Stores 25 vis of each primal aspect. Equip and use wand foci as you would with a wand.
tc.research_page.TB.Bracelet.Blaze.1: Stores 25 vis of each primal aspect. Equip and use wand foci as you would with a wand.
tc.research_page.TB.Bracelet.Ice.1: Stores 25 vis of each primal aspect. Equip and use wand foci as you would with a wand.
tc.research_page.TB.Bracelet.Quartz.1: Stores 25 vis of each primal aspect. Equip and use wand foci as you would with a wand.
tc.research_page.TB.Bracelet.Void.1: Stores 27 vis of each primal aspect. Equip and use wand foci as you would with a wand.
tc.research_page.TB.Bracelet.Primal.1: Stores 30 vis of each primal aspect. Equip and use wand foci as you would with a wand.
tc.research_page.TB.Bracelet.Ichor.1: Stores 150 vis of each primal aspect. Equip and use wand foci as you would with a wand.
tc.research_page.TB.Bracelet.Recap: To replace the caps, place the bracelet in the arcane workbench center and put two matching researched caps to its left and right. Stored vis and the installed focus carry over.
tc.research_page.TB.Briar.1: Harvest seed bags from mature briar. Combine them with sugar and a glass phial at the arcane workbench. The syrup clears harmful effects and leaves an empty phial.
tc.research_page.TB.Aurelia.1: Grow Aurelia under the open sky. During a full moon it opens and occasionally sheds petals containing Auram.
tc.research_page.TB.Spike.Iron.1: After a killing blow, use enchanted fabric on the spike to collect blood.
tc.research_page.TB.Spike.Thaumic.1: After a killing blow, use enchanted fabric on the spike to collect blood. Redstone disables the thaumic spike.
tc.research_page.TB.Spike.Void.1: After a killing blow, use enchanted fabric on the spike to collect blood. Void spikes leave players alone and hit mobs with player-attributed damage.
tc.research_page.TB.BloodyRobes.1: Craft the set from bloody cloth at the arcane workbench. The robe increases maximum health, the leggings improve attack knockback, and the boots increase movement speed. All three pieces reduce vis costs.
tc.research_page.TB.CryingObs.1: Stack two obelisk blocks vertically and right-click with an empty hand to set your respawn point. Leave a clear two-block-high space beside the base.
tc.research_page.TB.Backprocessing.1: With the right essentia, a crucible can turn processed ingredients back into their source materials.
tc.research_text.TB.Knose: A forgotten plant from a lost world…
tc.research_page.TB.Knose.1: Plant the sprout on a solid crystal block. A mature Rosa Mysteria drops a fragment corresponding to the crystal below it. Use fragments to gain research points, or convert them into Knowledge Fragments in a crucible. Tainted fragments can give you warp.
tc.research_text.TB.Pyrofluid: A short trip to the Nether
tc.research_page.TB.Pyrofluid.1: Treat a bucket of lava with Ignis and Praecantatio in the crucible. Pour out the pyrofluid and wait for it to crystallize. Break the crust to collect blaze powder. The liquid flows like lava and burns on contact. Scoop up the source with an empty bucket before it crystallizes.
tc.research_page.TB.Amber.1: Combine a spruce log with Vinculum in a crucible to create amber.
tc.research_page.TB.SimpleDublication.1: A few carefully selected aspects let you duplicate arrows, snowballs and redstone in a crucible.
tc.research_page.TB.RainbowCacti.1: Plant the cactus on sand. Once it grows, harvest the upper segments for dyes. Breaking the lowest segment returns the cactus. Its spines do not cause damage.
item.thaumicbases.focus_activation.unrea: The bound block is out of reach
tc.research_page.TB.Foci.Activation.1: Sneak and right-click a block to bind the focus. Right-click again to activate it remotely in the same dimension. Potency increases the range by 32 blocks per level.
tc.research_page.TB.AdvancedEntropy.1: Perditio can break down wool into string, sandstone into sand, and blaze rods into blaze powder. Each process returns three units of material.
tc.research_page.TB.MasterEntropy.1: Adding Fabrico to the process increases the yield to four units per operation.
tc.research_page.TB.OreDestruction.1: Mine infused stone with Silk Touch, then break it down in the crucible with Perditio, Praecantatio and the primal aspect of the ore. Each block yields eight shards.
tc.research_page.TB.Campfire.1: Right-click the campfire with a log, then add furnace fuel. Greatwood and silverwood logs last longer. A lit campfire drives nearby monsters away, although some may still approach.
tc.research_page.TB.Brazier.1: Place the brazier near a jar of Ignis or a linked essentia mirror. It draws one unit of Ignis from up to six blocks away and burns for 80 seconds, repelling nearby monsters.
tc.research_page.TB.StrongEntropy.1: Perditio reduces glass and gravel to sand. It can also break iron bars down into three iron nuggets.
tc.research_page.TB.Foci.Drain.1: Hold right-click and aim at water to clear it. The resulting air pocket keeps nearby liquid out briefly and can be filled by placing a block.
tc.research_page.TB.Foci.Drain.2: At rank three, Aquatic speeds up water removal and can yield crystallized Aqua or Venenum. Netheric lets the focus remove lava for additional Ignis.
focus.upgrade.tb_aquatic.name: Aquatic
focus.upgrade.tb_aquatic.text: Drains water faster and may produce crystallized essentia.
focus.upgrade.tb_netheric.name: Netheric
focus.upgrade.tb_netheric.text: Lets the focus drain lava using additional Ignis.
item.thaumicbases.focus_experience.cost: Vis cost scales with block hardness or creature health.
tc.research_page.TB.Foci.Experience.1: Right-click a block to consume it and get twice the experience it normally drops. Blocks without an experience drop yield a small amount based on Potency. Vis cost scales with hardness.
tc.research_page.TB.Foci.Experience.2: Decomposing converts creatures into additional experience based on their remaining health. The second rank halves the cost. It is incompatible with Vaporizing.
tc.research_page.TB.Foci.Experience.3: Vaporizing can turn the aspects of a consumed block into crystallized essentia. The second rank guarantees this for blocks with aspects. It is incompatible with Decomposing.
focus.upgrade.tb_decomposing.name: Decomposing
focus.upgrade.tb_decomposing.text: Converts creatures into experience. Rank II halves the cost.
focus.upgrade.tb_vaporizing.name: Vaporizing
focus.upgrade.tb_vaporizing.text: May recover crystallized essentia from consumed blocks. Rank II always recovers available aspects.
tc.research_page.TB.Foci.Flux.1: Hold right-click and aim at flux goo or gas to clear it. The focus uses Ordo while active.
tc.research_page.TB.Foci.Flux.2: Warping adds temporary warp when clearing flux, with a small chance of gaining sticky warp.
tc.research_page.TB.Foci.Flux.3: Calming requires Warping and reverses its effect. Clearing flux can reduce temporary and sticky warp.
tc.research_page.TB.Foci.Flux.4: Crystallization yields Potentia crystals. At rank II it yields a random aspect. This upgrade is incompatible with Warping and Calming.
focus.upgrade.tb_warping.name: Warping
focus.upgrade.tb_calming.name: Calming
focus.upgrade.tb_calming.text: Clearing flux reduces warp. Requires Warping.
focus.upgrade.tb_crystallization.name: Crystallization
focus.upgrade.tb_crystallization.text: Produces a Potentia crystal, or a random aspect at rank II.
tc.research_page.TB.Revolver.1: Hold the revolver in your main hand, sneak and swing it to open the chamber. Put a filled jar of Telum in the jar slot. Right-click to load two shots from one unit of Telum, then right-click to fire. Sneaking improves accuracy.
item.thaumicbases.revolver.upgrade.accur: Slightly tightens the spread. Incompatible with Speed and Efficiency.
item.thaumicbases.revolver.upgrade.speed: Increases projectile speed. Incompatible with Accuracy and Efficiency.
item.thaumicbases.revolver.upgrade.effic: Loads an extra shot per level from each unit of Telum. Incompatible with Accuracy and Speed.
item.thaumicbases.revolver.upgrade.heavy: Adds two points of melee attack damage per level.
Slowly repairs the revolver and adds one point of Warp per level while held.
item.thaumicbases.revolver.upgrade.eldri: Increases damage against eldritch mobs and Endermen.
item.thaumicbases.revolver.upgrade.dueli: Increases damage against players where PvP is enabled.
item.thaumicbases.revolver.upgrade.eldri: Increases damage to bosses and reduces damage to other targets.
item.thaumicbases.revolver.upgrade.knowl: Killing a creature can add its aspects to your research pool.
item.thaumicbases.revolver.upgrade.taint: Deals extra damage to ordinary targets and can inflict taint poison. Deals less damage to tainted creatures.
item.thaumicbases.revolver.upgrade.pierc: Shots can pass through multiple creatures and deal 10% more damage.
item.thaumicbases.revolver.upgrade.prima: Shots pass through blocks, travel twice as fast and deal double damage. One unit of Telum loads one shot before Efficiency.
tc.research_page.TB.HerobrinesScythe.1: Strike a hostile creature to send lightning jumping from one nearby hostile creature to the next. The scythe repairs itself over time, increases movement speed and adds three points of Warp while held.
tc.research_text.TB.ThaumicAnvil: Why haven't they thought of this?
tc.research_page.TB.ThaumicAnvil.1: You have replaced the iron in an ordinary anvil with thaumium. The result wears out more slowly and can handle operations costing up to 59 levels. Previous work on an item does not increase the price here, and work done here does not add a penalty.
tc.research_page.TB.VoidAnvil.1:
Void metal has given the anvil its ability to mend itself. Damage fades with time or when a nearby block updates.
Every valid operation costs exactly seven levels, whether you are renaming a tool or combining powerful enchanted books. Prior anvil work does not raise that price.
tc.research_page.TB.Relocator.1:
You have adapted the arcane levitator to work on walls and ceilings. The Nitor version pushes entities away from its active face. Using Alumentum instead makes a device that pulls them towards it.
Each block adds up to ten blocks of reach when stacked behind the active device. Solid blocks stop the beam, and redstone switches it off.
Use a wand on a face to aim the device. Sneak while using the wand to aim it the opposite way.
tc.research_page.TB.EldritchBane.1: Eldritch Bane adds five points of damage per level against Endermen and eldritch creatures. It can reach level V and cannot be combined with other damage enchantments such as Sharpness or Smite.
tc.research_page.TB.AdvAlc.1: You have reinforced an alchemical furnace with thaumium, letting it handle the heat of Alumentum. While burning Alumentum, it processes ingredients twice as fast. Ordinary fuel works at the usual speed. Arcane bellows can speed it up further, and alembics collect essentia as usual.
tc.research_page.TB.Vaporising.1: A melee weapon with this enchantment can turn some of a slain creature's aspects into crystallized essentia. Higher levels improve the chance and the variety of crystals. The enchantment goes up to level III.
tc.research_page.TB.ElderKnowledge.1: Weapons with Elder Wisdom sometimes grant research points for the aspects of creatures slain in melee. The chance rises with each level, up to level V.
tc.research_page.TB.MagicTouch.1: Weapons with Magic Touch release extra primal vis orbs from creatures slain in melee. Higher levels give more chances to draw out their vis.
tc.research_page.TB.Tainted.1: Drop a sword into the centre of a tainted aura node and leave it there until the node imbues it. The level is random, from I to III. Against creatures unaffected by taint, the blade adds three points of damage per level and may inflict Taint Poison.
tc.research_page.TB.Overchanter.1:
Put an enchanted item on the table and tap it twice with a wand. The table draws 32 Praecantatio from jars and mirrors within eight blocks. Halfway through, it requires 30 experience levels from one player within six blocks.
The first eligible enchantment gains one level, even above its usual maximum. The table remembers which enchantments it has already improved on that item. To cancel or collect the item, use the table with an empty hand. Cancelling does not refund spent essentia or levels.
message.thaumicbases.overchanter.loaded: Item placed. Tap this table twice with a wand.
message.thaumicbases.overchanter.empty: Place an enchanted item on the table.
message.thaumicbases.overchanter.exhaust: This item has no enchantments left to improve.
message.thaumicbases.overchanter.armed: Tap again with a wand to start.
tc.research_page.TB.NodeLinker.1:
Place one linker directly above each of two aura nodes within 32 blocks. Tap the receiver with a wand, then tap the donor. The transfer drains the donor's vis and consumes its capacity. Each point of capacity has a 70% chance to strengthen the receiver when the transfer is stable.
Instability may release flux or destroy the donor. Sneak and tap either linker with a wand to disconnect.
message.thaumicbases.node_linker.selecte: Receiver selected. Tap the donor's linker.
message.thaumicbases.node_linker.unavail: Both linkers must be free, above aura nodes, and within 32 blocks.
tc.research_page.TB.EntityDec.1: Right-click the placed deconstructor with an empty hand to claim it. It slowly damages creatures standing on it and grants you research points for their aspects. By default you must stay within 128 blocks. At long distances, knowledge may be lost to warp.
tc.research_text.TB.EntityDecAdv: Six crystals to stabilize the transfer
tc.research_page.TB.EntityDecAdv.1: Once you complete this research, right-click the deconstructor with blocks of Air, Fire, Water, Earth, Order and Entropy crystal. Each unique crystal adds ten blocks of range and makes transfer safer. With all six, the deconstructor never corrupts knowledge and can process dropped items into primal research points.
message.thaumicbases.entity_deconstructo: Only the owner can upgrade this deconstructor. Claim an unowned one with an empty hand.
tc.research_text.TB.Revolver.Accuracy: Slightly tightens the spread. Incompatible with Speed and Efficiency.
tc.research_text.TB.Revolver.Speed: Increases projectile speed. Incompatible with Accuracy and Efficiency.
tc.research_text.TB.Revolver.Efficiency: Loads an extra shot per level from each unit of Telum. Incompatible with Accuracy and Speed.
tc.research_text.TB.Revolver.Heavy: Adds two points of melee attack damage per level.
tc.research_text.TB.Revolver.Void: Slowly repairs the revolver and adds one point of Warp per level while held.
tc.research_text.TB.Revolver.EldritchBan: Increases damage against eldritch mobs and Endermen.
tc.research_text.TB.Revolver.Dueling: Increases damage against players where PvP is enabled.
tc.research_text.TB.Revolver.Eldritch: Increases damage to bosses and reduces damage to other targets.
tc.research_text.TB.Revolver.Knowledge: Killing a creature can add its aspects to your research pool.
tc.research_text.TB.Revolver.Tainted: Deals extra damage to ordinary targets and can inflict taint poison. Deals less damage to tainted creatures.
tc.research_text.TB.Revolver.Piercing: Shots can pass through multiple creatures and deal 10% more damage.
tc.research_text.TB.Revolver.Primal: Shots pass through blocks, travel twice as fast and deal double damage. One unit of Telum loads one shot before Efficiency.
tc.research_page.TB.NodeMan.1: Stabilizers keep a node in place, and transducers can tear it apart. Most thaumaturges stop there, yet nodes come in so many forms: tainted, pure, hungry, bright or fading. Combining both powers should let you move the smallest fibres of a node and reshape it.
tc.research_page.TB.NodeMan.2: The device joins the stabilizing power of an Advanced Node Stabilizer with the tearing force of a Node Transducer. Mirrors keep vis moving back and forth, vis relays carry it, and Salis Mundus holds the whole construction together.
tc.research_page.TB.NodeMan.3: The manipulator works only with a regular aura node directly below it; energized nodes are too powerful. On its own it does nothing: it needs a special manipulator focus to tell it how to reshape the node.
tc.research_page.TB.NodeMan.4: Use the device with a focus to insert it. Use it with an empty hand to take the focus out, or with another focus to swap them. Removing or swapping a focus resets the progress. Each focus works at its own pace.
tc.research_page.TB.Enchantments.1: Thaumaturges who infuse their tools with their own life energy may notice new formations of magic on them. These new enchantments can give a thaumaturge what they desire.
tc.research_page.TB.Enchantments.2: Weapons enchanted with Elder Wisdom may grant knowledge about the creatures they slay.
tc.research_page.TB.Enchantments.3: Weapons enchanted with Eldritch Bane deal more damage to endermen and eldritch creatures.
tc.research_page.TB.Enchantments.4: Weapons enchanted with Magic Touched draw more primal aspects from slain enemies.
tc.research_page.TB.Enchantments.5: Weapons enchanted with Vaporising may turn the life essence of slain creatures into crystallized essentia.
tc.research_page.TB.Enchantments.6: Weapons infused with Taint deal additional tainted damage and poison their target with taint, but are weaker against tainted creatures.
tc.research_page.TB.NodeFoci.Bright.1: Turns a normal node into a bright one. Works only on nodes without a modifier. Takes 20 minutes.
tc.research_page.TB.NodeFoci.Destr.1: Slowly destroys the node: bright becomes normal, normal becomes pale, pale becomes fading, and a fading node disappears. The escaping vis leaves the node as aspect orbs that any wand can absorb.
Whenever an aspect is drained from the node, there is a 50% chance it is returned. Works with wands, recharge pedestals and any other devices.
tc.research_text.TB.NodeFoci.Hunger: It is pretty obvious what this focus does
tc.research_page.TB.NodeFoci.Hunger.1: Turns a normal node into a hungry one. Takes 5 minutes. A hungry node may devour the manipulator itself.
tc.research_page.TB.NodeFoci.Unstable.1: Turns a normal node into an unstable one. Takes 7 minutes.
tc.research_page.TB.NodeFoci.Purity.1: Turns a normal node into a pure one. Takes 3 minutes. The node does not gain the aspects pure nodes usually have.
tc.research_page.TB.NodeFoci.Sinister.1: Turns a normal node into a sinister one. Takes 6 minutes.
tc.research_text.TB.NodeFoci.Speed: Restoration is a key to success
tc.research_page.TB.NodeFoci.Speed.1: The node restores its aspects much faster.
tc.research_page.TB.NodeFoci.Stability.1: Slowly restores the node. Fading becomes pale in 5 minutes, pale becomes normal in 10 minutes. Removing the sinister type takes 2 minutes, unstable takes 7 minutes and hungry takes 30 seconds.
tc.research_page.TB.NodeFoci.Taint.1: Turns a normal node into a tainted one. Takes 6 minutes. The node does not gain the aspects tainted nodes usually have.
